audit.whatIsWrong: Early lane says he 'can only Q-slow and walk' — his walk-up damage is unnamed and Granite Shield is absent.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs up to 10% of his max health and recharges when he goes unhit, so single-shot poke is refunded; Thunderclap (W, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) is an auto-reset that adds on-hit aftershocks, which is the actual walk-up threat.
audit.corrected: Poke in bursts to break Granite Shield rather than trickling shots; his step-up damage is Thunderclap, not item ticks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike does not give Unstoppable Force's cooldown.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the difference between a free window and a dead Akshan.
audit.corrected: Level 6: Unstoppable Force is 130s at rank 1; every one he throws buys you two full minutes of swing freedom.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ground Slam's attack-speed slow and its armour scaling never reach the page.
audit.why: Ground Slam (E, 7s, 400 range) deals magic damage scaled off his own armour and slows attack speed — so his armour stacking is offence, not just defence, and the slow cuts the double-shot pattern your trades rely on. Unstoppable Force is a dash-knockup that collides with you mid-Heroic-Swing.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam scales its magic damage with his armour and slows your attack speed; armour items are not a purely defensive purchase for him.

edits.before: Your passive double-shot lands and E (Heroic Swing) unlocks — Avengerang out-and-back plus the second shot chip an immobile Malphite who can only Q-slow and walk, never trade range.
edits.after: Your passive double-shot lands and Heroic Swing unlocks — but poke in bursts: Granite Shield eats up to 10% of his max HP and recharges whenever you leave him alone for a few seconds.

edits.before: His Unstoppable Force is the lane's swing button — a wall-ignoring knockup that interrupts your Heroic Swing mid-arc and hands his jungler a free reset on you.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force (130s at rank 1) is the lane's swing button — a wall-ignoring knockup that ends your Heroic Swing mid-arc and hands his jungler a free reset.

edits.before: Sunfire plus stacked armor flatly reduces your physical R and Q — your lethality does nothing to his armor while his R keeps perma-pick pressure on a shieldless you.
edits.after: Armour is offence for him: Ground Slam's magic damage scales off it and its attack-speed slow cuts your double-shot, while his R keeps perma-pick pressure on a shieldless you.

edits.before: Land Q slow, walk up, and Sunfire-tick you while you eat the free auto-trade he can't avoid
edits.after: Land Seismic Shard's slow, walk up, and Thunderclap you while you eat a free auto-trade

edits.before: Your second passive shot lands at level 2 and an MR-less, immobile Malphite can only slow and walk; you out-trade with double-shot poke he can't return.
edits.after: Your second passive shot lands at level 2, but Granite Shield refunds trickle poke — trade in bursts that break the 10% max-HP layer, then reset.

edits.before: His Unstoppable Force interrupts your Heroic Swing mid-arc through walls and hands his jungler a free reset, so 6 swings the lane to him.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force collides with your Heroic Swing mid-arc through walls and hands his jungler a free reset, so 6 swings the lane to him.

edits.before: This is your window. With E unlocked you poke with Avengerang, then Heroic Swing off a wall for a burst and swing back out before he can Q-slow you for a Sunfire walk-up. Once you hit Youmuu's the all-in becomes lethal — but the moment he hits 6, Unstoppable Force is a wall-ignoring knockup that interrupts your swing mid-arc and sets up a gank, so respect it. When his R is down he is a free target; when it's up, never commit your Heroic Swing where he can interrupt it.
edits.after: This is your window. With E unlocked you poke with Avengerang, then Heroic Swing off a wall for a burst and swing back out before Seismic Shard (8s) slows you into a Thunderclap walk-up. Once you hit Youmuu's the all-in becomes lethal — but the moment he hits 6, Unstoppable Force is a wall-ignoring knockup on a 130s cooldown that ends your swing mid-arc and sets up a gank. When his R is down he is a free target for two minutes; when it's up, never open with Heroic Swing.

notes: The kit file's derived 'grounding' flags on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam contradict Riot's own descriptions (neither text grounds), so I did not assert any anti-dash interaction against Heroic Swing — treat those flags as tooltip-parse misfires. Unstoppable Force in the packet's suspectNames is a false positive: it is the correct R name.
